annotations.text: On May 17th, prices of U. S. Steel and Bethlehem Steel were recorded in the Natural Reaction column, and the next day, May 18th, the price of U. S. notes:
Chart Ten (pages 120-121), year 1939, covering the ledger period April 20 - June 1, 1939. The Livermore Market Key grid is on the RIGHT page (121); the two printed annotation paragraphs are on the LEFT page (120). Group order left-to-right: U.S. STEEL, BETHLEHEM STEEL, KEY PRICE; within each group the six columns are SR, NR, UT, DT, NRC, SRC.

Six carried-forward pivotal points sit on the "1939 / DATE" header line above the first dated row (APR20): three red Downward-Trend points (US 44 3/8, BS 51 5/8, KP 96) drawn slightly higher, and three blue Natural-Rally points (US 50, BS 58 1/2, KP 108 1/2) below; all six carry double black underlines.

Only eight dated rows contain handwritten entries (May 17, 18, 19, 25, 26, SAT 27, 29, 31); all other rows (APR20-MAY16, SAT20-24, and JUNE1) are blank. May 30 (Tue) was Memorial Day and has no ledger row, consistent with the labels jumping 29 -> 31 -> JUNE1.

All KP = US + BS checksums verify exactly for every row where all three are present, which was used to confirm ambiguous fractions and column placement. Two entries are drawn as short red dashes rather than digits: BS Downward-Trend on May 19 (= 51 5/8, confirmed by the annotation) and BS Natural-Rally on SAT May 27 (= 58 1/2, recovered from the KP checksum 107 7/8 - 49 3/8); both are marked uncertain because their numeric value is inferred, not written.

Ink convention held throughout: UT would be black (none present on this chart), DT entries red, and SR/NR/NRC/SRC entries blue pencil. Drawn underlines: single black under US DT 43 1/4 (May 18) and KP DT 94 7/8 (May 19); double black under all three May 31 Natural-Rally figures (US 50 1/8, BS 60, KP 110 1/8), the BS one appearing as a merged/solid heavy line.
